situation.eastwatch_stalls.title: The Eastwatch will not move
situation.eastwatch_stalls.text: Word from the Army of the Eastwatch: General Voss holds his ground and asks for more men before he advances.
situation.eastwatch_stalls.option.press_: Order him forward at once, by special messenger
situation.eastwatch_stalls.option.send_t: Send Colonel Rook to stiffen him
situation.eastwatch_stalls.option.wait_f: Let him wait ten days for his reinforcements
situation.eastwatch_stalls.inaction: No word goes to the Eastwatch; the army sits where it is.
situation.eastwatch_followup.title: The Eastwatch advances
situation.eastwatch_followup.text: The army is moving. The War Ministry asks what support to send, and the papers ask what the First Minister will say.
situation.eastwatch_followup.option.prai: Praise the advance in the papers
situation.eastwatch_followup.option.reca: Call him back to his lines
situation.eastwatch_followup.inaction: The advance goes on with nothing more from the capital.
situation.fen_arrivals.title: Fen folk reach the Westwatch lines
situation.fen_arrivals.text: Families who fled the salt fens have crossed to the Westwatch lines, and more are on the roads. They came on their own, and they ask to stay.
situation.fen_crossing.title: The fen folk at the Westwatch
situation.fen_crossing.text: General Dale asks for instructions: the families who crossed to his lines from the salt fens ask to stay, and the men who held them demand them back.
situation.fen_crossing.option.shelter: Let them stay under the army's protection
situation.fen_crossing.option.send_back: Return them to the men who held them
situation.fen_crossing.inaction: Each commander decides for himself what to do with those who reach his lines.
situation.harbour_burning.title: Gullhaven burned
situation.harbour_burning.text: Southern troops burned the harbour town of Gullhaven. Reports of the dead disagree.
situation.sanctuary_act.title: The Sanctuary Act
situation.sanctuary_act.text: The Assembly has passed the Sanctuary Act: no officer of the North may send fen folk back to the salt fens.
